content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free web hosting service that allows users to host custom domains and static websites. When used in conjunction with NOWPayments, a crypto-only payment gateway, it becomes a powerful tool for selling digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms like PayPal or Stripe. This architecture matters because it gives digital creators control over their infrastructure, allowing them to own their data and operate independently of third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by hosting the digital product store on GitHub Pages, which provides a free and scalable hosting solution. The store is then integrated with NOWPayments, which handles payment processing and verifies transactions on the blockchain. This setup enables digital creators to sell their products without relying on traditional payment platforms, and to process payments in a secure and transparent manner.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on traditional payment platforms. It is particularly useful for creators in countries where PayPal or Stripe are unavailable or severely restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. By using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, these creators can host their products and process payments without incurring high fees or worrying about platform restrictions.
By using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, digital creators can host and sell their products independently of traditional payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this architecture work together include GitHub Pages, a free web hosting service, and NOWPayments, a crypto-only payment gateway. Additionally, the solution requires a basic understanding of how to integrate these components, which can be achieved through online tutorials and documentation. By using these components, digital creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows them to host and sell their products independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, from the COREMERCH website (https://coremerch.github.io/products.html); download and install the necessary software and tools; configure the architecture by integrating GitHub Pages and NOWPayments; test the solution to ensure it works as expected; and deploy the store to a custom domain.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
The 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad.

Your Deployment Checklist

Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate GitHub Pages with NOWPayments?

To integrate GitHub Pages with NOWPayments, you'll need to configure the payment gateway by providing your API credentials and setting up the payment flow. This can be achieved through online tutorials and documentation, which provide step-by-step instructions on how to integrate the two components.
Can I use GitHub Pages for free?
Yes, GitHub Pages offers free web hosting for custom domains and static websites. This makes it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to host their products without incurring high fees.
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on every sale, which is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad.
How do I configure the payment flow on GitHub Pages?

To configure the payment flow on GitHub Pages, you'll need to set up a payment gateway by providing your API credentials and configuring the payment flow. This can be achieved through online tutorials and documentation, which provide step-by-step instructions on how to integrate the payment gateway with GitHub Pages.
Can I use NOWPayments with other payment gateways?
Yes, NOWPayments can be integrated with other payment gateways, such as Stripe and PayPal, to provide a more comprehensive payment solution.
